content.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5（200054）发布：① 修复虚拟摇杆松手后角色一直往前跑，补齐系统取消（ACTION_CANCEL/切后台）兜底，取消时全量抬键并清空指针占用，保留推到底保持前进；② 修复游戏文件校验并补全在手机上失败，空下载源依赖不再构造即崩溃、本地已校验文件自动跳过、缺源且缺失时给出带文件路径与 SHA-1 的可读错误；③ 修复导出整合包失败，复制前自动建父目录，系统保存对话框按格式带正确后缀（Modrinth=.mrpack，其余=.zip）；④ 社区大厅自定义联机节点 URL 非法时不再闪退，弹出可读提示并恢复等待页；⑤ 修复游戏内物品栏点不准/连跳两次，一次手势只在松手时按最终槽位切换一次。包名 com.kcl.pcl 不变，可直接覆盖安装 kcl.4。

KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.5 (200054): ① fixed the virtual joystick making the player run forward after release — system-cancel paths (ACTION_CANCEL / background) now release all keys and clear occupied pointers, keeping the push-to-edge hold-to-run lock; ② fixed game-file verification/completion failing on phones — empty-source deps no longer crash at task build, already-validated local files are skipped, missing sources yield a readable error with file path and SHA-1; ③ fixed modpack export — parent dirs created before copying and the save dialog carries the correct extension per format (Modrinth=.mrpack, others=.zip); ④ an invalid custom lobby node URL no longer crashes the app — a readable toast is shown and the waiting page restored; ⑤ fixed the in-game hotbar mis-tapping / double-switching — one gesture switches to the final slot once on release. Package com.kcl.pcl unchanged; install over kcl.4.
